text:
Maya K.: Heads up — spotted a shortlink acting weird in the KB. rwd.ai/s/km/batching is bouncing in a redirect loop (301 -> 302 -> back) and the embedded images are 403ing. Sentry shows a spike for the past 48h. Can someone claim ownership or suggest a quick rollback?

docs-bot: [automated] shortlink-scan: detected possible redirect loop for alias /s/km/batching (scan id abc123).

Sam R.: Can you paste the exact shortlink URL and one example of a broken image? I can triage if it's a CDN signed-url issue or a redirect rule.

Maya K.: Sure — shortlink: https://rwd.ai/s/km/batching and one broken img: https://cdn.rwd.ai/assets/runtime/batching/diagram-1.png  (returns 403). Repro: open the shortlink in incognito -> browser tries to GET /s/km/batching -> 301 to /kb/runtime/batching -> 302 to /s/km/batching (loop).

Eli P.: Sounds like a stale shortlink redirect landing on a rewrite that points back. Quick check: grep for the alias in the repo: 
```
rg "s/km/batching" -n docs/ || true
```
There might be a leftover redirect in docs/_redirects or in the routing plugin. If we update the shortlink target to the canonical path /kb/runtime/batching-v2 it should stop the loop.

Zoë (docs-ops): I can take this. If it's just a redirect change I can patch the shortlink mapping + update frontmatter to set canonical, open a tiny PR, and run the preview smoke test. ETA ~30m. Can you assign to me, @Maya K.?

Maya K.: Assigned to Zoë. Thanks! Also please add a note in the PR describing the Sentry spike and include the Sentry event id: evt_0a1b2c3d.

Sam R.: Quick test suggestion for the PR: after you change the mapping, run `curl -I https://rwd.ai/s/km/batching` and ensure you get a single 301 -> /kb/runtime/batching-v2 (no loop) and then load the page to confirm images 200.

Zoë (docs-ops): Will do. If anyone sees other shortlinks pointing at /kb/runtime/batching (old), ping me in this thread and I'll sweep them.

Maya K.: :thumbsup: appreciate it.

Sam R.: Thanks Zoë — LMK when preview is up and I'll eyeball the page for any leftover inline shortlinks.

Zoë (docs-ops): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — changed redirect target and updated frontmatter. Preview link: https://preview.rwd.ai/kb/runtime/batching-v2 (smoke looks green, images load).

Sam R.: Verified preview — redirects fixed and images 200. Marking this resolved on my side.

Maya K.: Great, I'll merge after CI. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
